title: Introduce RAG Debug Annotator and Snippet Suggester (quickstart + docs)
author: Aisha N. Patel
release_notes: Adds a developer-facing RAG debugging toolkit: an annotator UI, snippet-suggester quickstart (TS/Python), and docs with troubleshooting recipes.
description:
Summary: Adds a lightweight RAG Debug Annotator tool and a Snippet Suggester quickstart to help engineers iteratively debug retrieval+generation failures. Motivation: debugging RAG sessions is time-consuming because errors can live in retrieval, prompt engineering, tool calls, or model fallbacks. This PR provides an opinionated developer workflow: capture a session trace, annotate tokens and retrieval hits inline, and surface suggested prompt/snippet rewrites to improve grounding and tool invocation reliability. What this PR includes: - A minimal web-based annotator (React) that loads a session trace JSON and overlays: token-level highlights, retrieval hit provenance links, and tool-call traces. - A Snippet Suggester engine (TS + Python examples) that generates small prompt edits and candidate tool wrappers based on heuristics and eval traces (prefix length, hallucination markers, and failing tool sigs). - Quickstarts: TypeScript quickstart with devcontainer and local runner, Python quickstart (async worker) showing how to attach the annotator to live sessions. - Docs: new devguide page with step-by-step troubleshooting recipes, metrics to watch (prefix coverage, retrieval recall, prompt entropy), and recommended guardrails for canarying prompt rewrites. - Tests: unit tests for the suggester heuristics and e2e smoke for the annotator renderer. - Telemetry: optional debug-only traces emitted as a compact trace.json format and small additions to the console's sample traces examples. Why this is useful: developers can reproduce a failing RAG session locally, iterate on targeted prompt edits suggested by the suggester, and validate fixes with the same trace format used in production. Checklist: - [x] Annotator UI implemented and wired to local trace loader - [x] Snippet Suggester: TS implementation + Python reference wrapper - [x] Quickstart README & devcontainer added - [x] Docs page with recipes and example traces - [x] Unit and e2e tests added to harness - [x] CI linting and typechecks passing

Commit summary: - feat(annotator): initial React app and trace viewer
- feat(suggester): implement heuristic-based snippet suggester (TS)
- docs: add devguide/troubleshooting/rag-debug-annotator.md
- examples: add ts and python quickstarts, devcontainer and sample trace.json
- test: unit tests for suggester heuristics and renderer smoke tests
- ci: add workflow for annotator smoke tests

Changed areas (high-level): - examples/rag-debug-annotator/ - web/annotator/* (React app, small CSS and bundler config) - examples/quickstarts/rag-snippet-suggester-ts/ (quickstart code + README) - examples/quickstarts/rag-snippet-suggester-py/ (async worker + attach script) - docs/devguide/troubleshooting/rag-debug-annotator.md - tests/annotator/* and tests/suggester/* - .github/workflows/annotator-smoke.yml
Notes on backwards compatibility: this is entirely additive. Trace format includes a small new optional field "annotatorHints" but parsers ignore unknown fields; no migration required. Telemetry is opt-in via a debug flag. Testing and CI: initial run hit a flaky renderer snapshot in CI; fixed by adding deterministic timestamp stubs (commit: test: stable snapshots for annotator). Final CI status: all checks passed on green. Review conversation (high-level excerpts): - Marco Liu (reviewer): "Nice end-to-end. Two asks: (1) make the suggester configurable with a simple threshold file, (2) add a tiny example that shows fixing a hallucination via a suggested snippet." - Aisha (author): "Done: added a config JSON and included the hallucination-fix scenario in examples/fixtures/hallucination-fix.trace.json. Also added docs snippet showing before/after prompts and token-level diffs." - Eve Chen: "Can we avoid shipping source maps in the quickstart container to keep image size small?" - Aisha: "Adjusted bundler to strip source maps for production devcontainer; left inline source maps in local dev mode." - Samir Kapoor: "LGTM overall; consider adding a brief note in the Console docs about how to attach live trace exports." - Aisha: "Added cross-link to console traces and a short example curl command in the docs." CI/Checks: - unit tests: passed - e2e smoke: passed - lint: passed - types: passed - preview docs build: passed Merge: squash and merged by Marco Liu on 2025-02-21. Release targeting: docs-next and examples bundle. Follow-ups (planned): - ENG-1421: add a small browser extension to capture traces from the Console UI - DOCS-58: expand troubleshooting recipes with additional canary checks - Short-term: collect anonymized tracer usage to validate heuristics (opt-in) Troubleshooting notes for reviewers: - If you see missing retrieval provenance links, verify the trace.json includes retrieval.entries[].sourceUrl (the suggester uses this for context). - For flaky renderer tests locally, run yarn test --updateSnapshot once after pulling to generate stable fixtures. Overall impact: developer experience improvement for debugging RAG workflows; no infra changes and no customer-facing surface changes.
